## Description

Please include a summary of the change, related issues, and context.

Fixes #(issue)

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change fixing an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change adding functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature causing existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Maintenance / CI / Tooling

## Component

- [ ] CLI (`telmoni-cli`)
- [ ] Auth (device-code login / API keys)
- [ ] Go SDK (`sdk/go`)
- [ ] Python SDK (`sdk/python`)
- [ ] TypeScript SDK (`sdk/typescript`)
- [ ] Rust SDK (`sdk/rust`)
- [ ] CI / Automation (`xtask`)

## Checklist

- [ ] `cargo xtask ci` passes locally
- [ ] Tests covering new logic or bug fixes are included
- [ ] Documentation has been updated where appropriate
- [ ] Code follows `#![forbid(unsafe_code)]` and workspace clippy deny rules
